notes: Subway: 3 USD contactless with OMNY, and free after 12 rides in a week. To JFK, take the AirTrain plus LIRR or the E train; a taxi is a flat 70 USD.
Museums: the Met costs 30 USD for visitors from outside New York, the AMNH 28 USD and MoMA 30 USD. Many offer "pay what you wish" on certain days.
Winter is 0-5°C with a chance of snow, so the plan leans towards museums. Christmas windows and ice rinks run in December; January brings sales.
Tip 18-22% in restaurants and 1-2 USD per drink at bars. Prices do not include tax (8.9%).
Bagels, slice pizza, pastrami and halal carts cost 5-15 USD; a sit-down meal is 30+ USD.
Book the first Statue of Liberty ferry and crown tickets months ahead; Top of the Rock is timed entry.

transit.name: OMNY (contactless)
transit.why_chosen: Contactless payment on subway and buses costs 3 USD per ride, and rides are free after 12 in a week
transit.where_to_buy: Kendi temassız kartın; OMNY kartı marketlerde 1 USD

days.theme: Midtown: Empire State, Bryant Park, Times Square

stops.name: Top of the Rock
stops.tips: Rockefeller Center's observation deck and the best view of the Empire State Building. Timed tickets (~47 USD); clearest in the morning.

stops.name: St. Patrick's Cathedral
stops.tips: Neo-Gothic cathedral on Fifth Avenue. Free entry.

stops.name: Ess-a-Bagel
stops.tips: A proper New York bagel: everything bagel with scallion cream cheese. The queue moves fast.

stops.name: New York Public Library & Bryant Park
stops.tips: The Rose Main Reading Room is free. Take a lunch break in the park.

stops.name: Times Square
stops.tips: Best when the lights come on in the evening. Get discounted same-day Broadway tickets at TKTS.

backups.name: Empire State Building
backups.tips: The 86th floor. The classic alternative to Top of the Rock.

backups.name: Los Tacos No. 1 Times Square
backups.tips: Adobada tacos (marinated pork). The best quick bite in Times Square.

stops.name: Statue of Liberty Ferry Battery Park
stops.tips: The first Statue City Cruises ferry leaves at 08:30 (~26 USD, pedestal included). Ellis Island has an immigration museum. Book crown tickets months ahead.

stops.name: 9/11 Memorial
stops.tips: The twin tower pools. Free entry; the museum costs ~33 USD.

stops.name: Oculus & Westfield World Trade Center
stops.tips: Calatrava's white station. Great for photos.

stops.name: Joe's Pizza Broadway
stops.tips: New York slice pizza. Fold it and eat it standing up.

stops.name: Brooklyn Bridge
stops.tips: The walk from Manhattan to Brooklyn takes 30 minutes. Continue to DUMBO for sunset.

backups.name: Staten Island Ferry
backups.tips: A free ferry. See the Statue of Liberty from the water without climbing the pedestal.

backups.name: Eataly Downtown
backups.tips: An Italian food market at the World Trade Center.

stops.name: Central Park
stops.tips: In winter, look for the Wollman ice rink and a snowy Bow Bridge.

stops.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
stops.tips: The Egyptian temple, Vermeer and the American Wing. 30 USD for visitors from outside New York; allow at least 2 hours.

stops.name: Levain Bakery Upper West Side
stops.tips: Giant cookies, right by Central Park.

stops.name: American Museum of Natural History
stops.tips: Dinosaurs and the blue whale. ~28 USD for visitors from outside New York.

backups.name: Shake Shack Upper West Side
backups.tips: Burgers, as an alternative to the cookies.

backups.name: Guggenheim Museum
backups.tips: Frank Lloyd Wright's spiral. An alternative to the AMNH.

stops.name: DUMBO Washington Street
stops.tips: The classic Manhattan Bridge frame. No crowds in the morning.

stops.name: Brooklyn Bridge Park
stops.tips: A riverside park with Jane's Carousel and the Manhattan skyline.

stops.name: Juliana's Pizza
stops.tips: Coal-oven pizza in DUMBO from the original Grimaldi's pizzaiolo. Opens at 11:30.

stops.name: Williamsburg Bedford Avenue
stops.tips: Vintage shops, record stores and cafés. Take the L train.

stops.name: Domino Park
stops.tips: A riverside park on the former sugar factory site, with Manhattan views at sunset.

backups.name: Peter Luger Steak House
backups.tips: A steakhouse since 1887. Cash only; book ahead.

backups.name: Brooklyn Heights Promenade
backups.tips: A walkway with views, lined with brownstones.

days.theme: High Line, Chelsea and Greenwich Village

stops.name: The High Line
stops.tips: A park on a former railway line. Walk from Gansevoort to 34th Street; quiet in the morning.

stops.name: Chelsea Market
stops.tips: A food market in the old Nabisco factory. Try Los Tacos No. 1 and a lobster roll.

stops.name: Whitney Museum of American Art
stops.tips: American art, plus terraces with views of the High Line.

stops.name: Washington Square Park
stops.tips: The arch and street musicians, with NYU all around.

stops.name: Greenwich Village Walk
stops.tips: Bleecker Street, the Friends building and a cupcake from Magnolia Bakery.

backups.name: Joe's Pizza Carmine Street
backups.tips: The original Joe's, in the Village.

backups.name: Little Island
backups.tips: An artificial island park over the river. An alternative to the Whitney.

stops.name: Museum of Modern Art
stops.tips: Van Gogh's Starry Night and Monet. Discounted after 16:00 on Fridays.

stops.name: The Halal Guys 53rd Street
stops.tips: Chicken over rice from a street cart, with white sauce.

stops.name: Fifth Avenue Stores
stops.tips: Saks, Tiffany and the Apple Cube. Christmas windows in winter.

stops.name: Grand Central Terminal
stops.tips: The zodiac ceiling and the whispering gallery. Stop at the Oyster Bar.

backups.name: Katz's Delicatessen
backups.tips: Pastrami sandwich, on the Lower East Side.

backups.name: Rockefeller Center Ice Rink
backups.tips: Ice skating and the Christmas tree in winter.

days.theme: Lower East Side: an easy farewell

stops.name: Russ & Daughters
stops.tips: Lox and bagels since 1914. A farewell breakfast.

stops.name: Tenement Museum
stops.tips: A guided tour of an immigrant tenement building. Book ahead.

stops.name: Little Italy Mulberry Street
stops.tips: Cannoli from Ferrara and the Italian neighbourhood.

stops.name: Chinatown Canal Street
stops.tips: Souvenirs and dim sum at Nom Wah Tea Parlor.

stops.name: Penn Station / AirTrain
stops.tips: AirTrain plus LIRR to JFK takes 45 minutes. Farewell.

backups.name: Clinton St. Baking Company
backups.tips: Pancake breakfast, as an alternative to Russ & Daughters.
